claims.name: Notebook.LinearCircuitFibonacci.fibonacci_scaled_prefix
claims.type:
∀ (r : Real) (n : Nat),
  instLTNat.lt n (instHAdd.hAdd 2 3) →
    Eq
      (Notebook.LinearCircuitFibonacci.fibonacci.observation (Matrix.vecCons 0 (Matrix.vecCons r Matrix.vecEmpty))
        (Matrix.vecCons 1 (Matrix.vecCons 0 Matrix.vecEmpty)) n)
      (Notebook.LinearCircuitFibonacci.extendedFibonacci.observation
        (Matrix.vecCons r (Matrix.vecCons 0 (Matrix.vecCons r Matrix.vecEmpty)))
        (Matrix.vecCons 0 (Matrix.vecCons 1 (Matrix.vecCons 0 Matrix.vecEmpty))) n)
